question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word. **

Abandon
solution:
The correct answer is '**Quit**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Abandon**' is '**Quit**'.
 
• **Abandon**: to leave somebody/something that you are responsible for, usually permanently. (किसी प्राणी या वस्‍तु को, जिस का उत्तरदायित्‍व आप पर है, प्रायः सदा के लिए छोड़ देना)
 
 
• *Example: The bank robbers **abandoned** the car just outside the city.*
 
 
 
• **Quit**: to leave a job, etc., or to go away from a place. (कोई नौकरी या स्‍थान छोड़ना) 
 
 
• *Example: She **quits** as manager of the volleyball team.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Quit.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Possess**: to have or own something. (किसी वस्‍तु को अधिकार में रखना या उस पर स्‍वामित्‍व होना)
 
• **Retain**: to keep or continue to have something; not to lose. (किसी वस्‍तु को रखना या बनाए रखना या रखे रहना; न गँवाना)
 
• **Rescue**: to save somebody/something from a situation that is dangerous or unpleasant. [(ख़तरनाक या अप्रिय सि्‍थति से) व्‍यकि्त या वस्‍तु को बचाना या का उद्घार करना]
